name: member-directory
title: Member directory
description: A list of person-cards, filtered live by a text field (the library's field) and by track checkboxes, with the filter state in the URL's query so a filtered view is shareable, a count read once by a status region, and a kind empty state that names the two fixes. Without JavaScript the full list shows, unfiltered, and the filters say they do nothing.

motif.gloss: No cultural motif; shared infrastructure, nothing drawn from a tradition.
